newsitem.title: GERMANY: Tietmeyer-Buba price stability reached,not at risk.
newsitem.headline: Tietmeyer-Buba price stability reached,not at risk.

text.p: Bundesbank president Hans Tietmeyer said on Thursday that the Bundesbank last year reached its goal of price stability and said that goal was not engangered in the foreseeable future.
Tietmeyer was speaking at a news conference following a regular policy-setting council meeting.
Tietmeyer also said that although there were some impulses for higher prices from abroad, these were being offset by moderate wage costs in Germany as well as by moderate domestic growth.
Tietmeyer said a broader economic upswing was being hampered by structural problems and that labour market inflexibility and global competition were hurting the jobs market.
He added that decisions needed to be taken soon on tax and welfare reform.
